translation: adv. 刚好；仅仅，勉强可能；几乎不；刚才
original_sentence: It was barely ten o’clock at night.
definitionEn: (1) only just; by a very small amount (2) almost not; hardly (3) only with great difficulty

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 几乎不，几乎没有（almost not，本身含否定义，不与 not 连用）
uncommonMeanings.example: She was barely aware of his presence.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 仅仅，刚刚（only just，强调刚达到某个数量、时间或程度）
uncommonMeanings.example: It was barely ten o’clock at night.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 勉强地，好不容易才
uncommonMeanings.example: His voice was barely audible.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 刚（做完某事）……就……（与 when 连用）
uncommonMeanings.example: John had barely finished his coffee when Henry returned.

posExamples.sentence: The lantern was barely visible through the fog.
She had barely enough time to catch the train.
The injured runner could barely stand unaided.

wordForms.adjective: bare 赤裸的；光秃的；最基本的（the bare facts 基本事实；bare necessities 最基本的生活所需；the barest hint of a smile 一丝几乎察觉不到的微笑）
wordForms.other: 【课件】bare 构词家族：bareheaded 光着头的 / barefoot 赤脚的（既是 adj. 也是 adv.：Alan came running barefoot through the house.）。注意：barely 是否定意味副词，位于 be动词/助动词之后、实义动词之前；不是 bare 的普通方式副词

collocations.translation: 课文原句：才刚到十点（barely＋数字＝刚刚，勉强达到）
collocations.example: It was barely ten o’clock at night. 晚上才刚到十点。
His voice was barely audible. 他的声音低得勉强能听见。
She was barely aware of his presence. 她几乎没注意到他在场。

collocations.translation: 【课件】刚刚，仅仅（强调刚达到某数量/年龄）
collocations.example: Gu Ailing is barely 18 and is already a world champion. 谷爱凌刚满18岁就已是世界冠军。
I barely recognized her. 我几乎认不出她来。

collocations.translation: 【课件】一……就……（主句过去完成时，when 从句一般过去时）
collocations.example: John had barely finished his coffee when Henry returned. 约翰刚喝完咖啡亨利就回来了。
They have barely enough money to live on. 他们的钱勉强够生活。
She barely managed to keep her balance.

synonyms.example: I can hardly believe it. 我简直不敢相信。
synonyms.usage: 【课件辨析】barely/hardly/scarcely 均为否定意味副词，句法位置相同（be动词/助动词后、实义动词前），置于句首均须部分倒装。hardly 否定语气最强，常与 any/ever 连用；barely 偏'勉强达到、刚刚够'（barely enough / barely 18）

synonyms.example: Scarcely had he sat down when the phone rang. 他刚坐下电话就响了。
synonyms.usage: scarcely 较正式书面；'一……就……'句型三者通用：Hardly/Scarcely/Barely...when...；No sooner...than...（注意 no sooner 配 than）

synonyms.example: He narrowly escaped death. 他死里逃生。
synonyms.usage: narrowly 只表'以极小差距'，几乎只与 escape/miss/avoid/win 等动词搭配；barely 可修饰形容词、数量和动词，使用面更广

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·否定副词句首的部分倒装（课件）

advancedExpressions.expression: Hardly/Scarcely...when...; No sooner...than...; On doing...; The moment/instant + 从句

advancedExpressions.expression: bare（光的、裸的）→ barely；bare+head+ed → bareheaded 光着头的；bare+foot → barefoot 赤脚（的）
advancedExpressions.example: Alan came running barefoot through the house.

translation: n. 雪茄烟
original_sentence: In the doorway of a store stood a man, with an unlit cigar in his mouth.
definitionEn: a tightly rolled tube of dried tobacco leaves that is smoked

posExamples.sentence: A half-smoked cigar rested in the ashtray.
The shop stores each cigar at controlled humidity.
He declined the cigar and opened a window.

wordForms.noun: cigar 雪茄烟（可数，复数 cigars）
wordForms.other: 重音在第二音节 /sɪˈɡɑː(r)/；对比 cigarette /ˌsɪɡəˈret/ 重音在末音节。构词：cigarette = cigar + -ette（'小'后缀，如 kitchenette 小厨房），即'小雪茄'→香烟

collocations.phrase: with an unlit cigar in his mouth
collocations.translation: 课文原句：嘴里叼着一支未点燃的雪茄（with 复合结构作伴随状语）
collocations.example: In the doorway of a store stood a man, with an unlit cigar in his mouth.

collocations.translation: 【课件】点燃着的雪茄（lighted 作前置定语）
collocations.example: Never leave a lighted cigar on the table. 别把点着的雪茄留在桌上。
The old man sat by the window smoking a cigar. 老人坐在窗边抽雪茄。
Cigar smoke drifted towards the ceiling.
He kept the letters in an old cigar box.
The satellite has a cigar-shaped body.

synonyms.example: He gave up cigarettes last year. 他去年戒了烟。
synonyms.usage: cigar 指整片烟叶卷成的粗雪茄；cigarette 是纸卷细香烟。二者都是普通可数名词，句法位置相同；课文中 an unlit cigar 是塑造人物（Bob）派头的细节

synonyms.example: He smoked a cheroot on the veranda.
synonyms.usage: cheroot 是 cigar 的一种，通常较细且两端切平；两者均作可数名词并可与 smoke/light 连用，不能与 cigarette 混为一谈。

translation: n. 约定，约会；任命，委任；职务
original_sentence: It’s an appointment made twenty years ago.
definitionEn: (1) an arrangement to meet someone at a particular time (2) the act of choosing someone for a job or position (3) the position itself

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 约定，约会，预约（与医生、律师等的正式安排；也指老友间的约定，如课文）
uncommonMeanings.example: It’s an appointment made twenty years ago.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 任命，委任
uncommonMeanings.example: They congratulated him on his appointment as principal.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 职务，职位（尤指要职）
uncommonMeanings.example: He has taken up an appointment as Professor of Chemistry.

posExamples.sentence: I have a dental appointment on Friday morning.
Her appointment as captain surprised the whole team.
The committee confirmed his appointment yesterday.

wordForms.noun: appointment 约定；任命；职位
wordForms.verb: appoint 任命，委派；约定（时间、地点）（appoint sb (as/to be) sth；appoint sb to do sth；be appointed to the committee）
wordForms.adjective: appointed 约定的，指定的（at the appointed time 在规定时间）
wordForms.other: 构词：appoint + -ment 名词后缀；重音在第二音节 /əˈpɔɪntmənt/。注意区分：appointment 事务性预约 ≠ date 恋爱约会 ≠ promise 承诺

collocations.phrase: an appointment made twenty years ago
collocations.translation: 课文原句：二十年前定下的约定（过去分词短语作后置定语）
collocations.example: It’s an appointment made twenty years ago.
You'd better make an appointment with the doctor in advance. 你最好提前和医生预约。

collocations.phrase: an appointment with sb / for sth / to do sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】与某人的约定；为某事的预约
collocations.example: I have an appointment to see the doctor. 我约好了去看医生。
Viewing is by appointment only. 参观须提前预约。
They congratulated him on his appointment as principal. 他们祝贺他被任命为校长。
He has taken up an appointment as Professor of Chemistry. 他已就任化学教授。
Please arrive at the appointed time. 请按约定时间到达。
Call ahead to cancel the appointment if necessary.

synonyms.example: I have a prior engagement. 我已有约在先。
synonyms.usage: engagement 较正式，另有'婚约'义；appointment 侧重与专业人士（医生、客户）的预约，二者都常接 with sb

synonyms.example: He asked her out on a date. 他约她出去约会。
synonyms.usage: date 指恋爱约会（go on a date），appointment 是事务性/正式预约，不可混用；课文 an appointment made twenty years ago 是老友间的郑重'约定'

advancedExpressions.expression: appoint sb (as) sth 任命某人为……；appoint sb to do sth 任命某人做某事；be appointed to the committee 被任命进委员会
advancedExpressions.example: She has recently been appointed to the committee.

translation: 拆毁，拆除
definitionEn: (1) to pull or knock a building or structure to pieces (2) to destroy an argument, barrier, or system

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 撕裂，撕破
uncommonMeanings.example: He tore the letter in two.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 眼泪（熟词多音多义：名词'眼泪'与动词'撕'同形不同音）
uncommonMeanings.example: Her eyes filled with tears.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 飞奔，疾驰（tear along/past/out of）
uncommonMeanings.example: A car tore past the school gate.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: tear down 还可指'抨击，驳倒（观点、制度）'
uncommonMeanings.example: He tried to tear down his opponent's argument.

posExamples.sentence: Workers will tear down the unsafe warehouse.
The dialogue helped tear down old prejudices.
She tore down the notice after the event.

wordForms.noun: tear /tɪə(r)/ 眼泪（in tears 流着泪）
wordForms.verb: tear-tore-torn 撕；拆；飞奔
wordForms.adjective: torn 撕破的；be torn between A and B 在A和B之间左右为难
wordForms.other: 同形异音异义：tear /teə(r)/ v. 撕 ↔ tear /tɪə(r)/ n. 眼泪。tear down 是'动词+副词'型可分短语动词：tear down the building ＝ tear the building down；代词作宾语必须放中间：tear it down

idioms.example: She burst into tears at the news. 听到消息她放声大哭。
He was in tears when he heard it. 听到这事他流泪了。

collocations.example: They plan to tear down the old theatre. 他们打算拆掉那座旧剧院。
She tore up the letter angrily. 她生气地把信撕碎了。
The war tore the country apart. 战争使这个国家四分五裂。
I could hardly tear myself away from the match. 我舍不得离开这场比赛。
She tore away the damaged label.
The dog tore at the old blanket.
The storm tore through the coastal town.
Critics tore into the poorly designed proposal.

synonyms.example: The old cinema was demolished last year. 那家老电影院去年被拆了。
synonyms.usage: demolish 正式书面语，及物动词，也可指'驳倒（论点）'；tear down 口语常用，是可分短语动词（tear it down，代词必须居中）

synonyms.example: The houses were pulled down to build a mall. 这些房子被拆掉建商场。
synonyms.usage: 与 tear down 基本同义可互换，同为'动词+副词'可分短语动词

synonyms.example: He was knocked down by a car. 他被汽车撞倒了。
synonyms.usage: knock down 指'拆除'时与 tear down 同义，但更常指'撞倒（人）'，注意语境区分

translation: adj. 灵敏的，敏锐的；渴望，热切，热衷于
original_sentence: When he lit his cigar, I could see his keen eyes and that square (2) _________________.
definitionEn: (1) very interested and eager (2) sharp or highly developed (3) strong and intense (4) intellectually quick

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 灵敏的，敏锐的（= sharp；修饰 eyes/mind/sense）
uncommonMeanings.example: Dogs have a keen sense of smell.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 渴望的，热切的，热衷的（keen to do / keen on / keen that）
uncommonMeanings.example: She is always keen to hear the local gossip.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 强烈的，浓厚的（= intense）
uncommonMeanings.example: He took a keen interest in skiing. / a keen sense of tradition

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 激烈的（竞争）
uncommonMeanings.example: Competition for the job was keen.

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （文）锋利的（刀刃）
uncommonMeanings.example: The knife has a keen edge.

posExamples.sentence: Young readers are keen to meet the author.
Eagles have remarkably keen eyesight.
A keen wind swept across the empty square.

wordForms.noun: keenness 热切；敏锐
wordForms.adjective: keen 敏锐的；渴望的；强烈的
wordForms.adverb: keenly 敏锐地；强烈地（be keenly aware of 深知）
wordForms.other: 比较级 keener，最高级 keenest；be keen on 是英式口语高频表达

collocations.translation: 课文原句：锐利的双眼（课件填空版，(2)处应填 jaw）
collocations.example: When he lit his cigar, I could see his keen eyes and that square (2) _________________. 他点雪茄时，我看清了他锐利的双眼和那方方的下巴（(2)处填 jaw）。

collocations.translation: 【课件】渴望做某事（= eager to do）
collocations.example: She is always keen to hear the local gossip. 她总是很想听当地的八卦。

collocations.translation: 【课件】特别喜欢做某事，热衷于做某事
collocations.example: He is keen on playing chess. 他热衷于下棋。

collocations.translation: 【课件】迫切希望……（that 从句用 (should)+动词原形）
collocations.example: He is keen that the company should expand its product range. 他迫切希望公司拓展产品线。

collocations.translation: 【课件】灵敏的嗅觉（keen = sharp 灵敏的，敏锐的）
collocations.example: Dogs have a keen sense of smell. 狗的嗅觉很灵敏。
She has a keen eye for a bargain. 她很会淘便宜货。

collocations.translation: 【课件】对……有浓厚的兴趣（keen = intense 强烈的，浓厚的）
collocations.example: He took a keen interest in skiing. 他对滑雪兴趣浓厚。
I'm keenly aware of the dangers. 我深知其中的危险。
The detective has a keen mind. 这位侦探头脑敏锐。

synonyms.example: She is eager to learn. 她渴望学习。
synonyms.usage: be keen to do ＝ be eager to do，都作表语接不定式；但 keen on doing 表'长期爱好、热衷'，eager 多表'一时的急切'（eager for sth）

idioms.example: He seems rude, but he's a rough diamond. 他看似粗鲁，其实是块未经雕琢的璞玉。

collocations.translation: 一颗镶嵌怪异的大钻石（课文原句）
collocations.example: His scarfpin was a large diamond, oddly set. 他的领带别针是一颗大钻石，镶嵌得很怪异。
He gave her a diamond ring. 他送给她一枚钻戒。
The crown is set with diamonds. 王冠上镶着钻石。
My grandparents celebrated their diamond wedding. 我祖父母庆祝了钻石婚。

collocations.translation: 钻石原石；外粗内秀的人
collocations.example: The cutter examined the rough diamond carefully.
The old diamond mine closed after flooding.
This diamond cut reflects light brilliantly.
A diamond-shaped sign marked the crossing.

synonyms.example: The museum displays jewels and gems. 博物馆展出各种珠宝。
synonyms.usage: 辨析：jewel/gem 泛指"宝石"，diamond 是其中一种；jewellery（美 jewelry）指"珠宝首饰"总称，不可数。

synonyms.example: The ring contains a small precious stone.
synonyms.usage: precious stone 是上位概念，作可数名词，可指 diamond、ruby 等；diamond 是其中一种，不能在要求具体宝石种类时任意替换。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·过去分词短语作后置定语（课文）
advancedExpressions.expression: a large diamond, oddly set = a large diamond which was oddly set；过去分词与被修饰词是被动关系

advancedExpressions.expression: a diamond ring 钻戒 / be set with diamonds 镶钻 / diamond wedding 钻石婚 / a rough diamond 璞玉
advancedExpressions.example: The watch, set with tiny diamonds, cost a fortune. 这块镶着小钻的表价值不菲。

advancedExpressions.type: 功能表达集合·小说细节描写

advancedExpressions.example: The large diamond showed that Bob had made his fortune in the West. 这颗大钻石表明鲍勃已在西部发了财。

translation: 发财
original_sentence: The next morning I was to leave New York and travel to the West to make my fortune.
definitionEn: to become rich or successful, especially through one's own work or business

uncommonMeanings.meaning: fortune [C] 一大笔钱；财富
uncommonMeanings.example: She inherited a fortune from her uncle. 她从叔叔那里继承了一大笔钱。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: fortune [U] 运气，机遇（= luck）
uncommonMeanings.example: By good fortune, he escaped unhurt. 幸运的是，他毫发无损地逃脱了。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: fortune（常用复数 fortunes）命运；盛衰变迁
uncommonMeanings.example: The film traces the changing fortunes of the family. 影片讲述了这个家族的兴衰。

posExamples.sentence: She made her fortune in renewable energy.
Many traders hoped to make their fortunes overseas.
He returned home after making his fortune abroad.

wordForms.noun: fortune 财富；运气 / misfortune 不幸 / fortune-teller 算命人
wordForms.adjective: fortunate 幸运的（反义 unfortunate）
wordForms.other: be fortunate to do / It is fortunate that… 幸运的是……；make one's fortune 中物主代词随主语变化：make my/his/their fortune(s)。

idioms.example: That car cost him a small fortune. 那辆车花了他一大笔钱。
Take the chance—fortune favours the brave. 抓住机会吧——天助勇者。

collocations.phrase: travel to the West to make my fortune
collocations.translation: 到西部去发财/闯荡（课文原句）
collocations.example: The next morning I was to leave New York and travel to the West to make my fortune. 第二天早上我就要离开纽约，去西部闯荡发财。
He made a fortune by developing oil business when he was young. 他年轻时靠做石油生意发了财。

collocations.translation: 【课件】寻找发财的机会；外出闯荡
collocations.example: A number of young people come to the city to seek their fortune. 许多年轻人来城市寻找发财的机会。
He went to sea to try his fortune. 他出海去碰运气。
This painting is worth a fortune. 这幅画值一大笔钱。
Repairing the house will cost a fortune. 修这房子要花一大笔钱。
The old woman offered to tell my fortune. 老妇人主动要给我算命。

collocations.phrase: have the good fortune to do sth
collocations.example: I had the good fortune to work with a brilliant head of department. 我有幸与一位杰出的系主任共事。

synonyms.example: He got rich by running an online store. 他靠开网店发了财。
synonyms.usage: 辨析：make one's fortune / make a fortune 是地道书面搭配，强调"挣得一大笔家财"；get rich 口语化，指"变富"这一结果；wealth 不可数，泛指财富，不与 make a 连用。

synonyms.example: Several prospectors hoped to strike it rich.
synonyms.usage: strike it rich 较口语，强调突然获得巨额财富；make one's fortune 可强调通过一段时间的事业成功致富，主语通常为人。

advancedExpressions.expression: make a/one's fortune 发财 · seek one's fortune 闯荡谋生 · try one's fortune 碰运气 · be worth a fortune 值一大笔钱 · cost a fortune 花一大笔钱 · tell one's fortune 算命 · have the good fortune to do 有幸做
advancedExpressions.example: He left home to seek his fortune and eventually made a fortune in trade. 他离家闯荡，最终经商发了财。

advancedExpressions.expression: 课文 "I was to leave New York" 中 be to do sth 表"按计划/注定将要做某事"，过去式 was/were to do 常带"命运安排"意味
advancedExpressions.example: The next morning I was to leave New York and travel to the West to make my fortune. 第二天早上我就要离开纽约，去西部闯荡发财。

advancedExpressions.expression: make one's fortune = make a fortune = make big money = get rich；"白手起家"= rise from rags to riches
advancedExpressions.example: The story of going west to make one's fortune was common in 19th-century America. 西进发财的故事在19世纪的美国很普遍。

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: She made her fortune in renewable energy, then invested much of it in cleaner technology.

classPractice.answer: had the good fortune to work with
classPractice.note: 原题型标注：完成句子（课件）。have the good fortune to do sth 有幸做某事；fortune 此处=运气，前有 the good 修饰。

classPractice.question: A number of young people come to the city to ____ ____ ____.（寻找发财的机会）
classPractice.note: 原题型标注：完成句子（课件）。seek one's fortune 外出闯荡、寻找发财机会；主语 young people，物主代词用 their。

classPractice.question: He ____ ____ ____ by developing oil business when he was young.（发财）
classPractice.note: 原题型标注：完成句子（课件）。make a fortune 发财；by doing 表方式。

classPractice.question: 第二天早上我就要离开纽约，去西部发财。（课文原句回译）（答案：____）
classPractice.answer: The next morning I was to leave New York and travel to the West to make my fortune.
classPractice.note: be to do 表计划/注定；make one's fortune 物主代词随主语用 my。

translation: 失去联系
definitionEn: to stop communicating with or receiving information from someone

uncommonMeanings.meaning: contact [U] 联系，联络；接触
uncommonMeanings.example: We stay in contact by email. 我们通过电子邮件保持联系。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: contact [C] 熟人，人脉，社会关系
uncommonMeanings.example: He has good contacts in the media. 他在媒体界有很好的人脉。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: contacts（口语，复数）隐形眼镜（= contact lenses）
uncommonMeanings.example: I can't find my contacts. 我找不到我的隐形眼镜了。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: contact 联系（某人）
uncommonMeanings.example: Please contact us by phone. 请电话联系我们。

posExamples.sentence: We lost contact after she moved abroad.
The control centre briefly lost contact with the aircraft.
Do not lose contact with trusted friends during difficult times.

wordForms.noun: contact 联系；接触；熟人
wordForms.verb: contact 联系（及物动词：contact sb，不说 contact with sb）
wordForms.other: 介词搭配口诀：动词 contact 直接跟人；名词 contact 前用 in/into——in contact with 保持联系，into contact with 发生接触。

collocations.example: After graduation, we lost contact with each other. 毕业后我们彼此失去了联系。

collocations.phrase: make contact with... / keep (stay) in (close) contact with...
collocations.translation: 【课件】与……取得联系 / 与……保持（密切）联系
collocations.example: I still keep in close contact with my old classmates. 我仍和老同学们保持密切联系。
It's good to come into contact with people from different cultures. 接触来自不同文化的人是件好事。
The shy boy avoided eye contact with the teacher. 那个害羞的男孩避免与老师目光接触。
He went to great lengths to maintain these contacts. 他竭尽全力维持这些关系。
She wears contact lenses instead of glasses. 她不戴框架眼镜，戴隐形眼镜。

collocations.translation: 【课件】（动词）联系某人（及物，不加 with）
collocations.example: Do not hesitate to contact me if you have any queries. 如有任何疑问，请随时联系我。
She re-established contact with her former classmate.

synonyms.example: We lost touch after she moved abroad. 她移居国外后我们失去了联系。
synonyms.usage: 辨析：lose contact with = lose touch with，完全同义可互换；"保持联系"= keep/stay in contact/touch with；"（主动）取得联系"= get in touch with / make contact with。

synonyms.example: We fell out of touch after graduation.
synonyms.usage: 两者后接人；fall out of touch with 强调联系逐渐中断，lose contact with 也可用于设备、飞机等突然失联。

advancedExpressions.expression: make contact with 取得联系 · keep/stay in (close) contact with 保持联系 · come into contact with 接触 · lose contact with 失联 · avoid eye contact 避免对视 · wear contact lenses 戴隐形眼镜 · contact sb 联系某人
advancedExpressions.example: Sailors' families kept in close contact with the rescue team. 船员家属与救援队保持密切联系。

advancedExpressions.expression: go to great lengths to do sth 竭尽全力做某事（课件在 contact 例句中同步讲解）
advancedExpressions.example: He went to great lengths to maintain these contacts. 他竭尽全力维持这些关系。

advancedExpressions.expression: lose contact/touch with 失联 · get in touch with 取得联系 · reach sb 联系上某人 · drop sb a line 给某人写短信/短笺
advancedExpressions.example: If you can't reach me, drop me a line. 联系不上我就给我留个信。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·状语从句（本单元语法）
advancedExpressions.expression: 条件状语从句 if…与课件例句连用：Do not hesitate to contact me if you have any queries.（if 从句用一般现在时表将来）
advancedExpressions.example: If you lose contact with the group, call this number. 如果你和队伍失联，就拨这个号码。

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: We lost contact after she moved abroad, though neither of us intended the silence to last.

classPractice.note: 原题型标注：完成句子（课件）。go to great lengths to do sth 竭尽全力做某事；contacts 此处指"人脉、关系"（可数）。

classPractice.question: Do not hesitate to ____ ____ if you have any queries.（联系我）
classPractice.note: 原题型标注：完成句子（课件）。contact 作动词是及物动词，直接接宾语，不加 with；if 引导条件状语从句（本单元语法）。

classPractice.question: After he moved abroad, we gradually ____ (lost contact with / contacted) each other, but I hope to get in touch with him again.
classPractice.note: lose contact with 失去联系（状态的失去）；contact sb 是"主动联系某人"，语义不符。

classPractice.question: 毕业后我们失去了联系，但去年又重新取得了联系。（答案：____）
classPractice.answer: We lost contact with each other after graduation, but got in touch (with each other) again last year.
classPractice.note: lose contact with ↔ get in touch with；也可用 lost touch with。

translation: adj. 可信赖的，可依靠的；真实可信的，可靠的
original_sentence: Being honest and taking responsibility mean that you are trustworthy, consistent and reliable.
definitionEn: able to be trusted to do what is expected or to work correctly and consistently

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （消息、信息）真实可信的
uncommonMeanings.example: Our information comes from a reliable source. 我们的信息来自可靠的来源。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （机器、系统）性能稳定的，靠得住的
uncommonMeanings.example: This is a cheap and reliable car. 这是一辆便宜又耐用的车。

posExamples.sentence: This watch is cheap but remarkably reliable.
We need reliable evidence before making an accusation.
Mina is a reliable partner under pressure.

wordForms.noun: reliability（可靠性）；reliance（依赖，依靠：reliance on sth）
wordForms.verb: rely（依靠，信赖；过去式/过去分词 relied）
wordForms.adjective: reliable（可靠的）；reliant（依赖的，be reliant on = be dependent on）；unreliable（不可靠的）
wordForms.other: 构词法：rely → reliable（y 变 i 加 -able，表'可被依靠的'）；重音在第二音节 /rɪˈlaɪəbl/；反义词加前缀 un-：unreliable

collocations.translation: 值得信赖、始终如一、可靠（课文原句）
collocations.example: Being honest and taking responsibility mean that you are trustworthy, consistent and reliable. 诚实和有担当意味着你值得信赖、始终如一、可靠。
The news comes from a reliable source. 这条消息来自可靠的来源。
We need reliable data to support the conclusion. 我们需要可靠的数据来支持这个结论。
You can rely on him to keep his word. 你可以相信他会遵守诺言。
Many students rely on their parents for money. 许多学生在经济上依靠父母。
It is reliably reported that the two sides have reached an agreement. 据可靠报道，双方已达成协议。
The court needs a reliable witness.
The railway provides reliable service throughout winter.

synonyms.example: A trustworthy friend never betrays your secrets. 值得信任的朋友绝不会泄露你的秘密。
synonyms.usage: trustworthy 强调'品德上值得信任'，多形容人；reliable 强调'不出差错、靠得住'，可指人、信息和机器。课文原句中两词并列作表语。

synonyms.example: She is hardworking and dependable. 她勤奋又可靠。
synonyms.usage: dependable 与 reliable 几乎同义，多形容人稳重可靠；reliable 使用范围更广。两者都可作定语或表语。

synonyms.example: Her story sounds credible. 她的说法听起来可信。
synonyms.usage: credible 指'（说法、消息）令人可以相信的'，一般不形容人品或机器：a credible explanation 可信的解释；a reliable source 可靠的来源。

advancedExpressions.expression: rely→reliable / depend→dependable / trust→trustworthy（-worthy）：都表'可以被……的'
advancedExpressions.example: 课件在 worthwhile 处也列出 trustworthy，-able 与 -worthy 都表'值得/可以被……'。

advancedExpressions.expression: reliable = dependable = trustworthy；'一向靠得住'可用 can be relied on to do sth
advancedExpressions.example: He can always be relied on to arrive on time. 他一向准时，很靠得住。

advancedExpressions.expression: rely on sb to do sth / rely on it that...（it 作形式宾语）
advancedExpressions.example: You may rely on it that he will come. 你尽管放心，他一定会来。

sentenceUpgrade.original: This watch is cheap but remarkably reliable.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: This watch is cheap but remarkably reliable, keeping accurate time through heat, dust, and rain.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 完整保留原句主语、事实与场景，再用伴随、原因或结果成分补充细节和逻辑

sentenceUpgrade.original: We need reliable evidence before making an accusation.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: We need reliable evidence before making an accusation, especially when the claim could damage a person's reputation.
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 完整保留原句主语、事实与场景，再用伴随、原因或结果成分补充细节和逻辑

classPractice.question: You can always rely ____ Tom, for he is one of the most ____ (rely) people I know.
classPractice.note: rely on/upon 固定搭配；名词 people 前用形容词 reliable。

classPractice.question: 据可靠报道，会谈进展顺利。It is ____ ____ that the talks are going well.
classPractice.note: 副词 reliably 修饰 reported：据可靠报道。

classPractice.question: 用 reliable / trustworthy 填空：① The figures are ____. ② He is an honest and ____ young man.
classPractice.note: 数据用 reliable（可靠无误）；人的品德用 trustworthy（值得信任），课文原句中两词并列。

translation: adj. 值得花时间（或花钱、努力等），重要的，令人愉快的
original_sentence: I came a thousand miles to stand in this doorway tonight, and it’s worthwhile if my old partner turns up.”
definitionEn: important, useful, or enjoyable enough to justify the time, money, or effort spent

posExamples.sentence: The difficult climb was worthwhile for the view.
It is worthwhile to compare several sources.
Volunteering made the holiday feel worthwhile.

wordForms.noun: worth（价值：ten dollars' worth of books 价值十美元的书）
wordForms.adjective: worthwhile（值得的，可作定语和表语）；worth（只作表语）；worthy（值得的，配得上的）
wordForms.other: 构词法：worth + while（一段时间）→ worthwhile'值得花时间的'；课件拓展 -worthy 后缀：trustworthy 可信赖的、noteworthy 值得注意的、praiseworthy 值得称赞的

collocations.example: I came a thousand miles to stand in this doorway tonight, and it’s worthwhile if my old partner turns up.” 我千里迢迢赶来，今晚站在这个门口，只要我的老朋友露面，这就值了。
We decided to give the money to a worthwhile cause. 我们决定把钱捐给一项有意义的事业。
The smile on her face made it all worthwhile. 她脸上的微笑让这一切都很值得。

collocations.phrase: make it worthwhile for sb to do sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】使某人做某事变得值得
collocations.example: High prices make it worthwhile for buyers to look abroad. 高价使买家去国外寻找货源变得值得。

collocations.phrase: It is worthwhile to do/doing sth
collocations.example: It is worthwhile to include/including really high-quality illustrations. 收入高质量的插图是值得的。
Good insulation is a worthwhile investment.
Most students found the workshop worthwhile.
The exchange programme was a worthwhile experience.

synonyms.example: 【课件】Most candidates are not worth interviewing. 大多数候选人不值得面试。
synonyms.usage: worth 只作表语，后接名词或 doing（主动形式表被动）：be worth doing / be worth the money；程度用 well worth，不用 very。

synonyms.example: 【课件】The matter is scarcely worthy of mention. 这事不值一提。
synonyms.usage: worthy 可作定语和表语；be worthy of + n./being done，或 be worthy to be done；worthwhile 则接 to do/doing 均可。

synonyms.example: Teaching is a demanding but rewarding job. 教书辛苦但很有意义。
synonyms.usage: rewarding 强调'带来回报和满足感'；worthwhile 强调'值得花时间金钱精力'，如 a worthwhile cause；两者都可作定语或表语。

advancedExpressions.expression: be worth doing = be worthy of being done = be worthy to be done = It is worthwhile to do/doing sth
advancedExpressions.example: The museum is worth visiting. = It is worthwhile to visit/visiting the museum. 这座博物馆值得参观。

advancedExpressions.expression: 课文中 it’s worthwhile if my old partner turns up 部分：if 引导条件状语从句（本单元语法：状语从句综述），条件状从中用一般现在时表将来（turns up）
advancedExpressions.example: It will be worthwhile if we finish the task ahead of time. 如果我们提前完成任务，那就很值得。

translation: adj. 感到内疚的，感到惭愧的；有罪的，有过失的

translation: adj. 惭愧，羞愧，尴尬

definitionEn: to stop feeling angry or resentful toward someone for an offence, mistake, or debt

idioms.idiom: through no fault of one's own
idioms.example: He lost the job through no fault of his own. 他丢了工作，但错不在他。

idioms.translation: 慷慨得过分（to a fault 过分地）
idioms.example: She is generous to a fault. 她慷慨得有些过头。

collocations.translation: 是某人自己的过错（课文原句）
collocations.example: Instead of being quick to blame others, analyse the problem, and if it is indeed your own fault, be ready to admit your mistake and then correct it. 不要急于责备别人，而要分析问题；如果确实是你自己的过错，就要勇于承认错误并加以改正。

collocations.translation: 【课件】……是某人的错（that 从句说明错误内容）
collocations.example: It's your fault that we are late. 我们迟到是你的错。

collocations.phrase: It's sb's fault for doing sth
collocations.example: It's your fault for not explaining it clearly. 是你的错，没把它解释清楚。
The official was at fault. 那位官员有责任。

collocations.phrase: for all its faults (= despite all its faults)
collocations.example: We love the city for all its faults. 尽管这座城市缺点不少，我们还是爱它。
The cook found fault with my work. 厨师挑剔我干的活。
The town lies close to a fault line.
The company admitted fault and paid compensation.

synonyms.example: I made a mistake in the calculation. 我计算出了错。
synonyms.usage: mistake 指行为或判断上的具体错误（make a mistake）；fault 强调错误的责任归属（It's my fault that... / be at fault），也指人或事物的缺点。

synonyms.example: Despite its shortcomings, the plan was accepted. 尽管有缺点，方案还是被采纳了。
synonyms.usage: shortcoming 常用复数，指性格或事物达不到标准之处，不含「责任」义；fault 既可指缺点也可指责任。

synonyms.example: The car was recalled because of a defect in the brakes. 这款车因刹车缺陷被召回。
synonyms.usage: defect 多指产品、身体上的实质性缺陷（a birth defect 先天缺陷）；fault 使用范围更广。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·fault 短语家族（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: It's sb's fault that... / It's sb's fault for doing... / be at fault / for all its faults / find fault with
advancedExpressions.example: The system, for all its faults, is the best available at the moment. 这个系统虽然缺点不少，却是现有最好的一个。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·状语从句（whenever 引导时间状语从句）
advancedExpressions.expression: whenever = every time 每当……（本单元语法：状语从句综述）
advancedExpressions.example: It weighed on me whenever the cook found fault with my work. 无论何时厨师挑剔我的活，都会给我带来压力。（课件例句）

advancedExpressions.expression: faulty 有缺陷的 ↔ faultless 完美无缺的
advancedExpressions.example: A faulty wire caused the fire; her performance was faultless. 一根故障电线引发了火灾；她的表演无可挑剔。

translation: n. 美德；正直的品性；优点
original_sentence: This way, you practise the virtue of courage.
definitionEn: behaviour or attitudes that show high moral standards; a particular good quality or habit; an attractive or useful quality (= advantage)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 美德，德行（总称，不可数）
uncommonMeanings.example: He led a life of virtue. 他过着有德行的生活。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （具体某种）美德，优秀品质
uncommonMeanings.example: Patience is not one of her virtues. 耐心并不是她的美德之一。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 优点，长处（= advantage）
uncommonMeanings.example: The plan has the virtue of simplicity. 这个方案的优点是简便。

posExamples.sentence: Patience is a virtue in scientific research.
The plan has the virtue of being inexpensive.
The speech praised courage and civic virtue.

wordForms.noun: virtue 美德；优点
wordForms.verb: —（无对应动词形式）
wordForms.adjective: 【课件】virtuous ① 品行端正的（a wise and virtuous man 睿智而品行端正的人）② 自命不凡的，自命清高的（He was feeling virtuous because he had finished and they hadn't. 他觉得自己很了不起，因为他完成了而他们没有）
wordForms.other: 发音 /ˈvɜːtʃuː/，注意 -tue 读 /tʃuː/；勿与 virtual/virtually（虚拟的；几乎）混淆，两词意义无关

idioms.translation: 把不得不做的事说成是出于善意；顺水推舟
idioms.example: Stuck at home, he made a virtue of necessity and learned to cook. 被困在家，他顺势学起了做饭。

collocations.translation: 践行勇气/正直的美德（课文原句）
collocations.example: This way, you practise the virtue of courage. 这样，你就在践行勇气这种美德。

collocations.translation: 【课件】过有德行的生活（virtue 总称义，不可数）
collocations.example: He led a life of virtue. 他一生品行高洁。
The plan has the virtue of simplicity. 这个方案有简便的优点。

collocations.translation: 【课件】认为做某事没什么好处
collocations.example: They could see no virtue in discussing it further. 他们认为再讨论下去没什么好处。
She got the job by virtue of her greater experience. 她凭借更丰富的经验得到了这份工作。
Research teaches the virtue of patience.
The lesson introduces the four cardinal virtues.

collocations.translation: 把不得已的事做得有价值
collocations.example: The team made a virtue of necessity and reused old materials.

synonyms.example: Judge each case on its merits. 应就事论事地评判每个案例。
synonyms.usage: virtue 既指道德美德也指事物优点；merit 指值得称赞的优点、价值，不含道德义；两者表「优点」时都可数。

synonyms.example: Living near school has one big advantage. 住得离学校近有个大好处。
synonyms.usage: advantage 强调相对他者的有利条件（have an advantage over）；virtue 表优点时更强调事物本身的可取之处（the virtue of simplicity）。

synonyms.example: She believes in the basic goodness of people. 她相信人性本善。
synonyms.usage: goodness 指内在的善良本性，不可数；virtue 更强调符合道德标准的品行，可指具体的一种美德。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·virtue 短语家族（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: lead a life of virtue / have the virtue of / see no virtue in doing / by (in) virtue of
advancedExpressions.example: The article stuck in my mind by virtue of one detail. 靠着一个细节，这篇文章一直铭记在我脑海里。

advancedExpressions.expression: by virtue of = because of = thanks to = due to
advancedExpressions.example: By virtue of hard work, she rose to the top. 凭借努力，她升到了顶层。

advancedExpressions.expression: virtue（n.）→ virtuous（adj. 品行端正的）→ virtuously（adv.）
advancedExpressions.example: a wise and virtuous man 一位睿智而品行端正的人（课件）

translation: n. 诚实正直；完整，完好
original_sentence: This way, you practise the virtue of integrity.
definitionEn: the quality of being honest and having strong moral principles; the state of being whole and undivided

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 完整，完好（熟词僻义：不是「正直」而是「整体性」）
uncommonMeanings.example: We firmly safeguard our territorial integrity. 我们坚定捍卫领土完整。

posExamples.sentence: She handled the dispute with complete integrity.
The bridge's structural integrity remains sound.
Data integrity depends on accurate records.

wordForms.noun: integrity 正直；完整 / integration 融合，一体化 / integer 整数（数学）
wordForms.verb: integrate（使）融合，（使）成为一体（integrate A into/with B）
wordForms.adjective: integral 必不可少的，作为组成部分的（an integral part of 不可或缺的一部分）
wordForms.other: 词根 integr-「完整」：integrity、integral、integrate、integer 同根；重音在第二音节 /ɪnˈteɡrəti/；不可数名词

collocations.translation: 践行正直的美德（课文原句）
collocations.example: This way, you practise the virtue of integrity. 这样，你就在践行正直这一美德。
He is widely respected as a man of integrity. 他作为正直的人广受尊敬。
She never compromised her moral integrity. 她从不牺牲自己的道德操守。
Copying in exams violates academic integrity. 考试抄袭违反学术诚信。
We must preserve the integrity of the old building. 我们必须保持这座老建筑的完好。
Engineers checked the dam's structural integrity.
The treaty respects each state's territorial integrity.

collocations.translation: 损害某物的完整性/公信力
collocations.example: Missing records compromised the integrity of the study.

synonyms.example: Honesty is the best policy. 诚实为上策。
synonyms.usage: honesty 指不说谎、不欺骗的诚实；integrity 层次更高，指坚守道德原则、言行一致的正直（a man of integrity），常与 moral/academic 搭配；两者均不可数。本单元主题 Honesty and responsibility 中两词呼应。

synonyms.example: Integrity is a virtue worth practising. 正直是值得践行的美德。
synonyms.usage: virtue 是美德的统称或某一种美德（可数）；integrity 是其中具体的一种品质（不可数）。课文原句即 the virtue of integrity。

advancedExpressions.expression: integrity（完整→人格完整→正直）/ integral 不可或缺的 / integrate 使成一体 / integer 整数
advancedExpressions.example: Music is an integral part of the school's life. 音乐是学校生活不可或缺的一部分。

advancedExpressions.expression: a man of integrity = an honest and upright person = a man of principle
advancedExpressions.example: Bob, a man of integrity, kept his promise made twenty years before. 鲍勃是个正直的人，信守了二十年前的承诺。

advancedExpressions.expression: with integrity 正直地 / academic integrity 学术诚信 / territorial integrity 领土完整
advancedExpressions.example: He conducted business with integrity. 他做生意诚信正直。

translation: adj. 有机的，统一的；绿色的，不使用化肥的；生物的
original_sentence: Society is an organic whole, and as social beings, we have a responsibility to make a contribution.
definitionEn: consisting of related parts that form a whole; produced without artificial chemicals; connected with living things

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 有机的，统一的（各部分紧密关联构成整体的）
uncommonMeanings.example: Society is an organic whole. 社会是一个有机整体。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 绿色的，不使用化肥农药的
uncommonMeanings.example: They only eat organic vegetables. 他们只吃有机蔬菜。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 生物的；有机体的
uncommonMeanings.example: Dead leaves add organic matter to the soil. 落叶给土壤增加有机质。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （正式）自然发展的，逐步的
uncommonMeanings.example: The company achieved organic growth. 公司实现了自然增长。

posExamples.sentence: The farm sells certified organic vegetables.
Dead leaves add organic matter to soil.
The group grew in an organic, unplanned way.

wordForms.noun: organ 器官；风琴 / organism 生物，有机体 / organization 组织
wordForms.verb: organize 组织
wordForms.adjective: organic 有机的 ↔ inorganic 无机的
wordForms.adverb: organically 有机地；用有机方法地
wordForms.other: 构词法：organ（器官）+ 形容词后缀 -ic → organic；反义前缀 in- → inorganic；注意重音后移：ˈorgan → orˈganic

collocations.translation: 一个有机整体（课文原句）
collocations.example: Society is an organic whole, and as social beings, we have a responsibility to make a contribution. 社会是一个有机整体，作为社会性的人，我们有责任做出贡献。
Organic food is often more expensive. 有机食品往往更贵。
Organic farming avoids chemical fertilizers. 有机农业不使用化肥。
The soil is rich in organic matter. 这种土壤富含有机物质。
She majors in organic chemistry. 她主修有机化学。
The company achieved steady organic growth.
The city collects organic waste separately.
Farmers applied for organic certification.

synonyms.example: The fabric is made from natural materials. 这种布料由天然材料制成。
synonyms.usage: natural 泛指非人造的、天然的；organic 特指不用化肥农药生产的（organic food），或指「构成有机整体的」（an organic whole）；两者都主要作定语。

synonyms.translation: 生物的；与生命过程有关的
synonyms.example: The filter removes biological material from water.
synonyms.usage: biological 强调生物或生命过程，常修饰 process/material；organic 还可表示有机食品、自然形成或有机化学。

advancedExpressions.expression: organ 器官 → organic 有机的 → organism 有机体 → organize 组织 → organization 组织机构
advancedExpressions.example: Every organism is made up of organs that work as an organic whole. 每个生物体都由器官组成，构成有机整体。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「一个统一的整体」
advancedExpressions.expression: an organic whole = a unified whole = an integrated whole
advancedExpressions.example: The essay reads as an organic whole. 这篇文章读起来是浑然一体的。

advancedExpressions.expression: organic food/farming/matter/chemistry; an organic whole
advancedExpressions.example: More farms are switching to organic farming. 越来越多的农场转向有机农业。

translation: n. 海星，星鱼
original_sentence: As a result, the passers-by felt inspired and joined him in saving the starfish.
definitionEn: a flat sea animal in the shape of a star with five (or more) arms

posExamples.sentence: A bright starfish clung to the rock.

wordForms.noun: starfish 海星（英式）＝ sea star（美式亦称）
wordForms.verb: —（无动词形式）
wordForms.adjective: —（无形容词形式）

synonyms.translation: 棘皮动物（上位类别，非同义）

The recovery gives us reason to rejoice.

synonyms.example: She was delighted at the result. 她对结果非常高兴。
synonyms.usage: 辨析：rejoice 是不及物动词（rejoice at/over/in sth），正式书面；delight 作动词是及物'使高兴'，人作主语时用被动 be delighted at/with，或 take delight in doing。

synonyms.example: They celebrated the victory with a party. 他们开派对庆祝胜利。
synonyms.usage: celebrate 是及物动词，宾语是'事件'（celebrate a birthday/victory）；rejoice 强调内心'欣喜'的情感，不能直接带宾语。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·时间状语从句 before/after（本单元语法：状语从句）

advancedExpressions.example: 课文原句：Worry before all others worry; rejoice after all others have rejoiced.（before/after 各引导一个时间状语从句）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「欣喜」（读后续写情绪升级）
advancedExpressions.expression: rejoice at = be overjoyed at = be thrilled at = jump for joy at
advancedExpressions.example: Hearing the news, the children jumped for joy. 听到消息，孩子们高兴得跳了起来。

translation: n. & vt. & vi. n. 引语 vt. & vi. 引用，引述；举例说明
original_sentence: This quote tells us that a person should act for the benefit of society at large.
definitionEn: (1) v. to repeat someone's exact words (2) v. to give a price (3) n. words repeated from another source (4) n. an estimated price

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （熟词僻义）报价；开价（give sb a quote for...; quote sb a price）
uncommonMeanings.example: The company gave us a quote for repairing the roof. 公司给我们开了修屋顶的报价。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （复数 quotes）引号（= quotation marks）
uncommonMeanings.example: Put the title in quotes. 把标题放在引号里。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （口语）quote...unquote 用于标示引文起止，含'所谓的'讽刺意味
uncommonMeanings.example: He is, quote, 'the best player ever', unquote. 他是所谓的'史上最佳球员'。

posExamples.sentence: The article quotes several climate scientists.
She began the speech with a familiar quote.
The builder quoted a fair price for the repairs.

wordForms.noun: quotation 引文，引语；报价（正式词）；quote 引语；报价（口语缩略）
wordForms.verb: quote 引用，引述；报价
wordForms.other: 语体贴士：quote 是 quotation 的口语缩略形式，两者'引语/报价'两义通用；'引号'说 quotation marks 或 quotes。读音 /kwəʊt/（单音节），注意别拼成 quata/qoute。

idioms.translation: （口语）引文开始……引文结束；所谓的（常含讽刺）
idioms.example: It was, quote, 'an accident', unquote. 那是所谓的'意外'。

collocations.translation: 这句引言告诉我们……（课文原句，点题句型）
collocations.example: This quote tells us that a person should act for the benefit of society at large. 这句引言告诉我们，人应为整个社会的利益而行动。
He often quotes from Shakespeare. 他常引用莎士比亚的话。

collocations.translation: 援引某人的话说……（新闻高频）
collocations.example: The report quoted him as saying the plan had failed. 报道援引他的话说计划失败了。

collocations.phrase: quote an example / quote sth as an example
collocations.example: She quoted several examples to support her view. 她举了几个例子支持自己的观点。
It's a famous quote by Fan Zhongyan. 这是范仲淹的一句名言。
The report includes a direct quote from the witness.
Do not quote her remarks out of context.
The final bill exceeded the quoted price.

synonyms.example: The paper cites several recent studies. 这篇论文引用了几项最新研究。
synonyms.usage: 辨析：quote 指'原样引述'某人的原话，常带引号，宾语可以是人或话语（quote him / quote his words）；cite 更正式，指'引……为证据/例子'，常用于学术（cite evidence/a study），不强调原文照录。

synonyms.example: She referred to the author's early works in her speech. 她在演讲中提到了该作者的早期作品。
synonyms.usage: refer to 只是'提到'，不引用原文；quote 必须给出（或近似给出）原话内容。

advancedExpressions.expression: quote from / quote sb as saying / cite...as an example / refer to
advancedExpressions.example: The article quoted the mayor as saying the project would continue. 文章援引市长的话说项目将继续。

advancedExpressions.type: 功能表达·作文引名言套句
advancedExpressions.expression: As the famous quote goes, "..." 正如那句名言所说……；This quote tells us that... 这句引言告诉我们……
advancedExpressions.example: As the famous quote goes, "Failure is the mother of success." 正如名言所说：'失败是成功之母。'

advancedExpressions.expression: quote（口语）→ quotation（正式）→ quotation marks 引号；misquote 错误引用
advancedExpressions.example: The newspaper apologized for misquoting the scientist. 报纸为错误引用那位科学家的话道歉。
